back.target: much, many, a lot of (quantifier before a noun; viele before plural nouns)
back.example: I don't have much time today.

note: The rules list determiners under glue, but viel has a plain English meaning and a picture, so content is a fair choice; still, the editor could tell the learner that "many" before a plural noun takes an ending (viele Leute), since the example only shows uncountable viel.
